review_description: As I said before the quote was very professionally laid out explaining all, The first quote came in a tad high but then they replaced Jinko panels with Trina panels (which I am happy to see made in South Australia) but would not change Goodwe inverter which dropped the price around $1,000.The installation  went very well the guys arrived at 8:30am and were finished including clean up removal of rubbish and old 2kWh system by 5:00pm They even worked through their lunch time to ensure the job was finished before the rain started which luckily stayed away most of the day. The only negative of the installation was one array isolation switch was inadvertently left in the off position but Scott Morton (the owner) came out and fixed the problem on the Sunday of the Anzac day weekend. I couldn't ask for any better service.SWM did all the dealings with S.A power including the Relevant Agent paperwork (of which I knew nothing about as last time approx. 7 years ago the relevant agent was unheard of). The grid connection and wifi connection and start-up was handled by Scott.
